CVE-2009-1143.title: An issue was discovered in open-vm-tools 2009.03.18-154848. Local ...
CVE-2009-1143.description: An issue was discovered in open-vm-tools 2009.03.18-154848. Local users can bypass intended access restrictions on mounting shares via a symlink attack that leverages a realpath race condition in mount.vmhgfs (aka hgfsmounter).

CVE-2014-4199.title: vm-support 0.88 in VMware Tools, as distributed with VMware Works ...
CVE-2014-4199.description: vm-support 0.88 in VMware Tools, as distributed with VMware Workstation through 10.0.3 and other products, allows local users to write to arbitrary files via a symlink attack on a file in /tmp.

CVE-2014-4200.title: vm-support 0.88 in VMware Tools, as distributed with VMware Works ...
CVE-2014-4200.description: vm-support 0.88 in VMware Tools, as distributed with VMware Workstation through 10.0.3 and other products, uses 0644 permissions for the vm-support archive, which allows local users to obtain sensitive information by extracting files from this archive.

CVE-2025-22247.title: VMware Tools contains an insecure file handling vulnerability. A  ...
CVE-2025-22247.description: VMware Tools contains an insecure file handling vulnerability. A malicious actor with non-administrative privileges on a guest VM may tamper the local files to trigger insecure file operations within that VM.
